ui.common.editing.conflict.note: This field changed in the persisted record while the operator had a dirty draft; asks for a choice without overwriting either value.

ui.common.editing.keep_mine.note: Resolve conflict using the operator current draft; retry the write against the refreshed record.
ui.common.editing.keep_mine.length: One control row; avoid adding a sentence.

ui.common.editing.use_theirs.tone: Contrast with Keep mine; other writer ownership choice.
ui.common.editing.use_theirs.note: Resolve conflict by accepting the fresh persisted value and discarding the local field draft.
ui.common.editing.use_theirs.length: One control row; avoid adding a sentence.
